quests.title: Possession at Bankstown
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Bankstown. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Berala Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Berala for 23 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, North Ryde
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at North Ryde because of one abandoned car, and it has been like that since the merge. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$34 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Birrong
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Birrong that I am scheduled to kill on the first of the month. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above ES Marks
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above ES Marks I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at quarter to six, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$38, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Tallawong
quests.blurb: Done at Tallawong on every second Friday for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Engadine
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Engadine, dead for 21 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Glenbrook
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Glenbrook.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$46 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above UNSW Anzac Parade
quests.blurb: 12 years above UNSW Anzac Parade. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since every second Friday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Redfern
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Redfern, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$36 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Heathcote
quests.blurb: The clock on the Heathcote platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Engadine, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Waterloo
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Waterloo at just gone midnight, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I have run out of ways to say it politely.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Yennora
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Yennora delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$38 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Yagoona
quests.blurb: The last one through Yagoona carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Birrong, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Birrong
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Wynyard Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Wynyard at ten past five and never taps off. Same card, 26 months running. Ride the run they ride and find where a person gets off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Bella Vista Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Bella Vista. Since school holidays they have not turned up, and they keep sending a different bloke. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Bella Vista kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $48 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Gordon

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes

quests.title: Unclaimed at Banksia

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
